phases.name: baseline
triggers: Unexplained ledger, source, grant or signature drift
Failed migration or strict assertion
Unauthorized scope, partial effect or changed historical evidence
Measured target gate or native acceptance failure

rollback.transaction_failure: Rollback the failing transaction; stop further installation and retain diagnostics
rollback.successful_phase_before_business_writes: Restore only the explicitly approved isolated snapshot, with owner authorization, or review an additive repair
rollback.after_business_writes: Coordinated approved restore or additive forward repair; no journal, open-item, serial, attachment or ledger deletion
rollback.scope: Never restore/reset shared acceptance or concurrent Wave 4; never execute generated destructive downgrade placeholders
